details:
I would like to request an improvement to the way VRChat handles window focus during startup, as there are currently two issues where focus unexpectedly switches without user interaction.

1. VRChat Repeatedly Steals Window Focus Shortly After Launching in VR Mode

When launching VRChat in VR mode, the VRChat window repeatedly forces itself into focus shortly after startup.

For example, after launching VRChat, I may continue working on my desktop before putting on my headset. However, the VRChat window suddenly takes focus, capturing my mouse cursor and interrupting whatever I am doing.

Even if I manually switch focus back to the window I was using, VRChat immediately takes focus again.

This typically happens two or three times shortly after launch, forcing me to repeatedly interrupt my work and making the experience quite frustrating.

This issue only occurs when launching VRChat in VR mode.

2. Focus Unexpectedly Switches to Another VRChat Instance When Running Multiple Instances

Unexpected focus changes also occur when multiple VRChat instances are running.

For example, if VRChat is already running in desktop mode and I launch another instance in VR mode, focus sometimes switches to the existing desktop-mode instance instead of the newly launched VR-mode instance.

I believe this is unintended behavior, as the newly launched instance should not cause an unrelated, already-running instance to unexpectedly take focus.

Requested Improvements

I would appreciate it if the window focus behavior during VRChat startup could be improved, particularly in the following areas:

Prevent VRChat from repeatedly forcing itself into focus shortly after launching in VR mode

Respect the user's decision to manually switch focus to another window, rather than immediately taking focus back

Ensure that launching a new VRChat instance does not unexpectedly cause another, already-running VRChat instance to take focus

Launching VRChat does not necessarily mean that the user intends to put on their headset and begin playing immediately.

I would greatly appreciate it if these issues could be addressed so that VRChat can be launched without unnecessarily interrupting other activities.

Thank you for your time and consideration!
title: Please Improve Unexpected Window Focus Changes When Launching VRChat
